config.title: Risk Assessment Configuration
config.complexDesc: Separate Impact and Likelihood factors. More detailed analysis, industry standard methodologies.
config.showIndividualFactorsDesc: When disabled, only aggregated Impact/Likelihood values are shown. Hover shows details.
config.roundingCeilDesc: Always rounds up to higher risk level
config.useAssetImpact: Pre-fill Impact from linked Asset severity
config.useAssetImpactDesc: When enabled, the worst aggregated impact of linked assets is used as the default Impact factor value. Analyst can still override per risk.
config.assetImpactMappingHint: Default mapping resets when scale changes.
config.severityThresholdsHint: Scores above the highest threshold always map to the last level.

risks.uncertainWarning: {{count}} risk(s) are based on uncertain threats — please confirm their relevance in the Threat Eval tab.

eliminate.label: Eliminate
eliminate.description: Remove the risk source entirely — the vulnerability or attack vector is fully resolved by the selected countermeasures. No residual risk remains.

reduce.label: Reduce
reduce.description: Lower the likelihood or impact through targeted countermeasures. A residual risk remains but is brought to an acceptable level.

accept.label: Accept
accept.description: Consciously retain the risk without implementing countermeasures. The risk is within defined tolerance thresholds. Justification required.

transfer.label: Transfer
transfer.description: Shift full responsibility for the risk to a third party (e.g. via insurance, contractual liability clause, or outsourcing). Justification required.

share.label: Share
share.description: Distribute responsibility across multiple parties — e.g. part of the countermeasure is implemented in the product, part in the surrounding system or operator procedures. Justification required.

should.label: Should
should.description: Important - should be addressed if possible

could.label: Could
could.description: Nice to have - could be addressed

wont.label: Won't
wont.description: Accepted risk - won't be addressed this iteration
